summary: Additional variables, periods and regional summaries beyond the requested GPP/dieback maps. Some climate-class files have invalid latitudes; one workbook's purpose is unclear.
Vegetation and reflectance summaries (LAI, NDVI and short-wave infrared). These derived indicators are distinct from the requested land-cover maps and field observations.
Heat-stress difference maps and regional daily/nighttime distributions extend beyond the requested products. Distribution tables lack embedded observation times and locations.
Trend maps, stress-response summaries, model parameter layers and uncertainty maps. These are additional results beyond the main forest-vulnerability maps described in the sheet.
Fish migration, reproduction, fishing-area and life-cycle map layers. They are present in the geodatabase but have no corresponding dataset description in the sheet.
Additional radiation and leaf-physiology observations, plus weather and an SPI drought index. The requested products use different measurements or SPEI, so these are not interchangeable.

Connectivity threshold tests, sensitivity results and aggregated analysis tables. These cover additional analyses or different thresholds, rather than the specific resistance maps and polygons requested.
Land-cover transition rates and statistical estimates of ecological effects. The sheet describes site measurements, rather than these derived transition and modeling results.
Forest-type area and average or median tree-diversity summaries. This aggregated result is additional to the datasets described in the sheet.
Derived tree-diversity estimates, matrices and statistical results. The sheet describes raw tree censuses and functional traits, rather than these analytical products.
Bird species traits and occurrence inferred from range maps. The sheet describes field captures, so these tables are different kinds of data.
Observed pollinator-diversity estimates, bootstrap results and variability summaries. These sampling-analysis outputs are not the products described in the sheet.
Habitat-loss and deforestation tables are separate from the requested connectivity metrics. Another file is named as connectivity results, but its contents have not been checked.
Amazon-wide carbon inversion estimates, fire counts and modeled fire emissions. These describe basin-wide processes, whereas the sheet requests measurements at the ATTO tower.
Outputs from a bundled 1981 hydrology run. The sheet describes a larger multi-scenario model and sediment retention; these local run outputs have not been shown to be those products.
Historical or coarse drought, forest-edge, fire and logging maps are present. The sheet describes future degradation scenarios; their relationship to these maps remains unconfirmed.
